items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Yeah, I played with Howard too, played with all of them

ctx.x: Well sometimes George Williams has had a band.

Well I played with him too. Dick Howard, different ones at times. Yeah, I played with Howard too, played with all of them, called himself one of the brass bands, played with all of them around there. You did mostly play for those clubs. Yeah, Mardi Gras. And Mardi Gras, well Mr. Bill I'm no young fella you see, and that walk was too much in that hot sun, I just couldn't make it too much. I played with them young trombone players, they'd come out there starting off, blowing a can, I tell them take it easy. See I…
You got a cute dog there. Isn't it?
